Method.name: ProcessXmlMessage
Method.Description: This Method creates Generic HTTP request and calls onMessage of the HTTP.GenericOperation to process the HTTP Request
Method.Implementation: #dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK #dim httpRequest As EnsLib.HTTP.GenericMessage $$$TRACE("Inside the ProcessXmlMessage") set httpRequest=##class(EnsLib.HTTP.GenericMessage).%New() do httpRequest.HTTPHeaders.SetAt("text/xml", "content-type") do httpRequest.HTTPHeaders.SetAt(0, "content-length") do httpRequest.HTTPHeaders.SetAt("POST","httprequest") //set httpRequest.Stream=stream do httpRequest.HTTPHeaders.SetAt("xml="_stream.Read(),"IParams_1") do httpRequest.HTTPHeaders.SetAt(1,"iparams") set tSC=..OnMessage(httpRequest,.httpResponse) quit tSC

CreateXmlStreamFromObject
Method.Description: This Method is used to create XML stream from the Object
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK #dim xmlString #dim xmlWriter As %XML.Writer
set xmlWriter=##class(%XML.Writer).%New() set xmlWriter.NoXMLDeclaration=1 do xmlWriter.AddInstanceNamespace("xsi") do xmlWriter.AddSchemaNamespace("xsd") do xmlWriter.OutputToStream(.stream) do xmlWriter.RootObject(object) quit stream

Method.name: CreateXmlStringFromObject
Method.Description: This Method is used to create XML String from the Object
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK #dim xmlString #dim xmlWriter As %XML.Writer
set xmlWriter=##class(%XML.Writer).%New() set xmlWriter.NoXMLDeclaration=1 do xmlWriter.AddInstanceNamespace("xsi") do xmlWriter.AddSchemaNamespace("xsd") do xmlWriter.OutputToString() do xmlWriter.RootObject(object) quit xmlWriter.GetXMLString(.tSC)
